Black basalt Wedgwood teapot.

Oriental style basalt teapot  with a moulded spaniel on the lid.
Dimension:
Overall: height 12.5cm × width 15cm × depth 11cm
Handle to Spout: 15cm
Text: Oriental style basalt teapot  with a moulded spaniel on the lid.  As pale skin was fashionable for ladies in the 19th century, black teawares especially teapots were particularly popular, as they emphasised the whiteness of a lady's hands.
